title: Iso-$μ/T$ holographic entropy and its attractor for a strongly coupled quantum fluid
summary: Numerical evidence has shown that a period of vanishing entropy production during far-from-equilibrium stages induces subsequent violations of the dominant energy condition in strongly coupled plasmas. This behavior also appears to hold for a Bjorken-expanding, hot and dense strongly coupled quantum fluid. In this context, it has been established that the chemical potential-to-temperature ratio ($μ/T$) in the medium increases with higher initial charge density, $ρ_0$, and/or lower initial energy density, $\varepsilon_0$.
